Mission Local reported that San Francisco State’s enrollment decline and budget shortfall were prompting major cuts, with lecturers bearing the brunt. The story said the cuts could amount to 125 full-time positions, while many part-time lecturers could lose classes or their entire workloads; some colleges faced cuts of about 30 percent. It also described lecturers’ uncertainty and the potential effects on course offerings.
